proposals.evidence: Turner *maricca, section 2 of marīca, gives Assamese maris, Bengali maric and eastern chilli senses. These Hajong muris/moris/moric forms are compared with that eastern retained-affricate/sibilant family, with vowel variation preserved. The separate *marucca northwestern branch is not inferred from muris alone.
